title: micromeria fruticosa subsp. barbata
intro: Micromeria fruticosa subsp. barbata, commonly known as a type of mountain tea or Crete mountain tea, is a plant species belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against various diseases and conditions. The therapeutic actions of Micromeria fruticosa subsp. barbata include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antidiabetic and anticancer activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
